text: Excellent dental clinic

I previously visited this clinic, but I was left with a strong sense of distrust and distress, and I stopped going midway through my treatment. Many other reviews I read contained exactly the same information as mine, and when I consulted with other acquaintances and dentists, they objectively pointed out that "the fees are abnormally high and the service is dishonest." I am convinced that this is the normal state of affairs at this clinic, and I am posting this as a warning.

1. Significant lack of transparency in fees and breakdowns (overcharging)
While other dental clinics charge around 500 baht for consultations, this clinic charges 850 baht, making the fees extremely high. Furthermore, there are far too many opaque aspects that make me suspect inflated charges, such as being strongly encouraged to have paid X-rays taken almost every time without a clear explanation of their necessity.

2. Lack of explanation regarding treatment and dishonest service
After treatment, there was absolutely no explanation of "what procedures were performed," leaving me terrified because I didn't know what was happening. Also, the explanations from the staff who spoke Japanese were false and inconsistent, making them completely untrustworthy both as individuals and as a medical institution. 3. Sloppy Technique and Service
The treatment was generally sloppy, resulting in significant pain and physical and mental strain. Some of the treatment was questionable as a medical practice, causing considerable stress.
4. Inconsiderate Customer Service and Atmosphere
The overall impression is that the service was unfriendly, and there was a constant, unpleasant tension in the clinic. It would be extremely difficult for introverts or those who want to entrust their oral care to a trustworthy professional.

This is the first time I've had such a terrible experience at a dental clinic. I don't want anyone else to go through the same unpleasant experience. I strongly recommend finding another clinic.
